SELECT
FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.master_id=#{masterId} and json_contains(a.sub_permission,CONCAT('',#{subjectId},''))

SELECT
FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.master_id = #{masterId}
SELECT a.id FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.master_id = #{portalId}

select per.user_access_id,u.username,info.first_name,info.last_name from gc_user_access_permission per left join gc_user_access access on access.id = per.user_access_id left join gc_user u on u.id = access.user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = u.info_id where access.master_id = #{masterId} and JSON_CONTAINS(per.sub_permission, CONVERT(#{subId}, CHAR)) = 1

SELECT
FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.master_id = #{masterId}

select a.* from gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.master_id = #{masterId} and ( JSON_CONTAINS(a.channel_permission,#{ptId}) or JSON_CONTAINS(a.subscribe_permission,#{ptId}))
select a.* from gc_user_access_permission a where (JSON_CONTAINS(a.sub_permission,#{ptId}) or JSON_CONTAINS(a.must_subject_json,#{ptId}) or json_contains(a.may_subject_json,#{ptId}))

SELECT
FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.master_id = #{masterId} and ua.role_json like concat('%',#{roleName},'%')

SELECT
FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.master_id = #{masterId} and ua.role_json like concat('%','groupMember','%')
